scenes.say: Agencies lose deals in the gap between proposal sent and getting paid. Dealwright is an AI agent that closes that gap, end to end, on PayPal.

actions.title: Dealwright
actions.subtitle: From first research to money in PayPal, with an AI agent and a human in the loop

scenes.say: It finds and researches prospects. Every lead carries real evidence, quoted from the prospect's own website.
One click, and the AI writes a scoped proposal with three pricing tiers, grounded in that evidence.
Then it becomes payable. One-time tiers use PayPal Orders. Monthly tiers become PayPal subscriptions, created on the fly.
This is the client's view. The proposal, and a PayPal button on every plan.
The client picks the monthly Growth plan, and approves it in PayPal.
Back in the CRM, nobody typed anything. PayPal confirmed the payment, the deal moved to Won, and the monthly revenue was recorded.
Every payment lands in a live ledger built with AG Grid. Filter it, sort it, and act right from the row.
Wren is the agent. I just ask in plain English. An LLM picks the PayPal tool, the client and the plan.

actions.text: Invoice CloudPulse for the one-time sprint

scenes.say: But it never moves money on its own. I confirm, and PayPal sends the invoice.
For anything unpaid, Wren drafts a reminder whose tone fits how overdue it is, and queues it for my approval.
Dealwright. PayPal Orders, Subscriptions, Invoicing, Refunds and Webhooks, driven by AI, with a human in the loop.
